body_html:
John has performed at numerous events around the world, such as the The Winter Olympic Trials, The Denver Bronco’s VIP Tail Gate Parties, The Bud Light Party Cruise, The final project on the Celebrity Apprentice, Corporate Awards Ceremonies, The Auburn University Arena Opening, 2005 NBA All Star Game, Denver Sports Commission Events, and Numerous Other High Profile Events.

John has also been in the entertainment industry since the age of 16 and has worked with multiple disc jockey companies, night clubs, radio stations, sports teams, and even a television station.

John is also currently the Public Address Announcer for the University Of Georgia Men’s Basketball Team, the field reporter/announcer for Football, and Public Address announcer for other CU Sports.

Some of John’s Previous Emcee and announcing events include:

  • The USA Olympic Trials,
  • The USA Boxing National Championship,
  • The Churchill Cup (Rugby),
  • The Harlem Globetrotters
  • Final Project on The Celebrity Apprentice with The Harlem Globetrotters,
  • University Of Georgia Men’s Basketball, Football, Volleyball, and Soccer,
  • Georgia State University and more!
  • Live Music Concerts including All-American Rejects, OAR, Bare Naked Ladies, and more!

He uses his entertainment diversity to expand his business and provide his clients with premier entertainment.
